items.source: Whether a cache_control breakpoint is placed on the last tool result message of a request, so that tool outputs are written to (and read from) the cache across tool-calling rounds. Takes effect with strategies whose eligible message types include tool results, i.e. AnthropicCacheStrategy.CONVERSATION_HISTORY; it is a no-op for strategies that only target tool definitions or system messages.
items.translation: 是否在最后一个请求工具结果消息上设置 cache_control 断点，以便跨工具调用轮次将工具输出写入（并从）缓存中读取。该选项对符合条件的消息类型包含工具结果的策略生效，例如 AnthropicCacheStrategy.CONVERSATION_HISTORY；对于仅针对工具定义或系统消息的策略，此选项无效。

items.source: Returns a new disabled cache options instance with strategy NONE.
items.translation: 返回一个禁用缓存选项的新实例，其策略为 NONE。

items.source: Returns a new disabled cache options instance with strategy NONE. Each call returns a fresh instance to avoid shared mutable state.
items.translation: 返回一个禁用缓存选项的新实例，其策略为 NONE。每次调用都会返回一个新的实例，以避免共享可变状态。
